title: Deposit Conditions on the Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements Form
content:
# Deposit conditions — Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements

These are the deposit conditions printed on the agreement form for each plan of Belrose Layaway and Hold Agreements. The figures are the plan's own.

| Plan | Minimum deposit share of the merchandise price | Minimum deposit amount (USD) | Share taken down on a specially ordered piece | Special order deposit non-returnable | Deposit returned on cancellation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30-Day Hold Agreement | 10 percent | 25.00 | 0 percent | no | yes |
| 90-Day Layaway | 20 percent | 50.00 | 0 percent | no | yes |
| 6-Month Layaway | 20 percent | 100.00 | 0 percent | no | yes |
| 12-Month Bridal Layaway | 25 percent | 250.00 | 0 percent | no | yes |
| Special Order Layaway | 50 percent | 250.00 | 50 percent | yes | no |
| Gift Registry Layaway | 15 percent | 100.00 | 0 percent | no | yes |

## What each column means

- **Minimum deposit share** is the smallest share of the merchandise price that must be put down at opening, as a percentage of the pre-tax price.
- **Minimum deposit amount** is the smallest deposit accepted at opening whatever the share works out at.
- **Share taken down on a specially ordered piece** is the share of the price taken down on a piece ordered in specially. Only the Special Order Layaway sets one, at 50 percent.
- **Special order deposit non-returnable** records whether a specially ordered piece's deposit is kept whatever happens afterwards. Only the Special Order Layaway says so.
- **Deposit returned on cancellation** records whether the deposit comes back when the agreement is cancelled. It comes back on every plan except the Special Order Layaway.

## Conditions as the customer reads them

You put down at least the plan's minimum share of the price, and never less than the plan's minimum deposit amount. On the Special Order Layaway, half the price is taken down on the specially ordered piece and that deposit is not returned. On every other plan the deposit is returned if the agreement is cancelled.
